d: Amber and Matt decorate their dream home, Catelynn departs treatment in Arizona with new insights, Farrah finally loses patience with Simon, and Maci worries Ryan is neglecting Bentley.
Gary struggles as Leah spends more time with Amber, Catelynn readjusts to life after treatment, Farrah celebrates her 25th birthday in Miami, and Maci welcomes her newest family member.
Farrah launches a new business, Ryan distances himself from Bentley and Larry on Father's Day, Amber decides to lose weight, and Tyler worries that Catelynn is resuming her unhealthy habits.
Amber takes Leah back-to-school shopping, Maci is apprehensive when Ryan resurfaces in Bentley's life, Farrah prepares Froco's grand opening, and Catelynn's mistake triggers dark thoughts.
Sophie decides the girls need a holiday to Blackpool while relationships between the boys hit a new low. Faith makes up with Chloe, although she might not remember much in the morning! (S18, ep3)
After their trip to Blackpool the gang couldn't be in a better place, but that soon changes. Faith falls out with Nathan, and tensions in Sam and Chloe's relationship spill over. (S18, ep4)
The truth finally comes out about Stephanie's relationship with Lauren's ex-boyfriend Doug.  Heidi's mother makes a surprise visit to LA and has a confrontation with Spencer.
Lauren gets a letter of apology from Heidi and realizes there's only one thing keeping them from being friends again.  Audrina starts dating a new guy to make Justin jealous, but her plan backfires.
Audrina reconnects with an old flame Cory and finds herself juggling two guys.  Spencer forces Heidi to kick her sister Holly out of the apartment.

Rachelle's parents always had big dreams for her. So when she got pregnant after only a month of dating her boyfriend, they were devastated. Being pregnant while getting to know the father is a lot to juggle, especially without her family's support.
Maddie and her mom Crystal were best friends until Maddie met her boyfriend, Korey. Crystal sees Korey as a bad influence on her daughter. Now that she's pregnant, the drama is even more intense.

Camryn was 14 when she met her boyfriend, Cam. His personality has often put him at odds with Camryn's mom. After finding out Camryn was pregnant and losing his job, he was forced to move into Sarah's house and try to put their issues to the side.

Kash has been with her boyfriend, Nate, for about a year but struggles with his immaturity. Kash has to see if Nate can handle these new adult responsibilities or if he's not ready to get serious with her.
Maci turns 25, Farrah deals with a challenging employee, Tyler celebrates Butch's important anniversary, and Matt's troubled son arrives as Amber tries to clear up nasty rumors.
Amber and Matt lay down strict rules for their houseguest, Farrah prepares her newest business, Maci enjoys her bridal shower, and Catelynn and Tyler's anniversary is marred by tough news.
Maci and Taylor party in Las Vegas, Catelynn explores equine therapy, Amber and Matt meet with a writer to set the record straight, and Farrah's conflict with Debra hits a boiling point.
Catelynn and Tyler face a setback with the new house, Farrah and Debra continue to feud, Amber steps in to help Gary and Kristina, and bride-to-be Maci hosts a family dinner.
Abbie and Adam struggle with their friendship and Nathan feels let down by Chloe who puts Sam first. Faith finally feels like she's one of the gang and Scott takes the crew Tank driving!
The Geordies try Burlesque dancing and invite their friends over for a games night. Anna sends them to Benidorm and the squad tear up the Strip but Sophie hits Sam after he calls her out.
Lauren and Audrina travel to Cabo for Brody's birthday, but the party turns into a fight.  Spencer humiliates Stephanie after learning that her new boyfriend is friends with Brody.

st: I Want You To Be With Me
